• 91 9062150656 Pind Daan in Pitru Paksha: Reality of Crowd & Costs
Planning a trip to Gaya Ji for Pind Daan during Pitru Paksha? Before you leave, watch this essential guide to understand the major differences between performing Pind Daan in ordinary days versus the busy Pitru Paksha period.
In this video, I share my personal experiences and insights from multiple visits to Gaya. Many people believe Pind Daan only happens during Pitru Paksha, but it's a year-round ritual. However, the experience during these 15 days is unique due to the massive crowds and shifting costs.
